channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Calera clamps down defensively, advances with win over Hueytown
item.description: Playoff basketball returned to Calera on Saturday, Feb. 14, and the Eagles made sure their home crowd had plenty to cheer about.

item.title: Pelham dominates Northridge for first Sweet 16 trip since 2023
item.description: The Pelham Panthers earned another dominant win against Northridge to book their trip to the Sweet 16.

item.title: Spain Park upsets No. 2 Paul Bryant on road to make first Sweet 16 since 2023
item.description: Spain Park pulled away in the second half to upset No. 2 Paul Bryant in a road sub-regional to make its first Sweet 16 since its 2023 Final Four run.

item.title: Thompson downs Tuscaloosa County for first 7A area championship
item.description: Thompson won its first area championship since 2013 as it held off Tuscaloosa County on the road behind big nights from Damonte Tabb, Riley Bryant and Cam Pritchett.

item.title: Spain Park, Chelsea, Pelham win individual wrestling state titles as Jags, Montevallo place highly
item.description: Spain Park’s London Ford and Bradley Williams, Pelham’s Sam Powell and Chelsea’s Porter Schott won individual state wrestling titles as Calera, Helena, Montevallo and Shelby County joined them with top-six finishers.

item.title: Thompson finishes second in 7A boys wrestling state championship, four win individual titles
item.description: Thompson finished in second in the Class 7A boys wrestling state championship as Braylen Johnson, Wyatt Carroll, Anna Gann and Lynleigh Weltzin brought home individual titles to Alabaster.

item.title: Flying high: Oak Mountain wins first wrestling state championship
item.description: The Oak Mountain Eagles won their first boys wrestling state championship by knocking off defending champion Thompson as Jameson Thomas, Quinn Ivey, Titus Slaughter and Trey Denny won individual titles.

item.title: Oak Mountain’s young talent embracing new mindset under O’Neal
item.description: Oak Mountain’s dynamic young players are motivated to break through this year with a new competitive mindset driven by first-year coach Telma O’Neal.

item.title: Chelsea’s Stratton Hodges signs with Coastal Alabama men’s golf
item.description: Chelsea’s Stratton Hodges signed a men’s golf scholarship with Coastal Alabama Community College to continue his athletic career at the next level.

item.title: Thompson JV boys soccer coach Michael Wilbanks reaches 250 wins
item.description: Thompson JV boys soccer coach Michael Wilbanks won the 250th match of his career to open the 2026 season, the latest milestone in a 25-year journey for the founder of Thompson’s middle school and JV programs.
